  - TargetUserName
  - TicketEncryptionType

arguments.summary: A golden ticket attack was identified originating from external IP 198.51.100.23 and internal compromised host 10.0.12.10. Threat actors performed network scanning and obtained Kerberos ticket-granting ticket (krbtgt) privileges, enabling lateral movement across Engineering and DevOps OUs. Immediate emergency response included revocation and rotation of 34 privileged accounts, double reset of the krbtgt account, firewall blocking of malicious IP, and endpoint quarantine. The incident was contained and eradicated, with post-incident hardening measures applied.

timeline.description: External IP 198.51.100.23 performed Nmap SYN scan against internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). IDS alert IDS-2026-03200 logged (low severity).
Suspicious Kerberos authentication attempts detected from internal IP 10.0.12.10 targeting krbtgt service.
Normal authentication event by user CORP\helpdesk on WS-IT-101.
SOC Lead Sarah Chen authorized emergency credential revocation and double reset of krbtgt (pre‑auth token EMERG-AUTH-7742).
Executed revocation and rotation of all 34 accounts in Engineering and DevOps OUs; krbtgt account reset twice.
Firewall rule added to block malicious IP 198.51.100.23 (inbound).
Full endpoint scan initiated on compromised workstation WS-IT-101; malicious artifacts quarantined.
Eradication completed: removal of unused service accounts, enforcement of Kerberos hardening playbook.
Incident declared contained; continuous monitoring established.
